meta_description: M.E Boilers is a Gas Safe registered engineer serving Bolton. Fast boiler repairs, installations and servicing. Emergency callouts available 24/7.
hero_subhead: Boiler broken in Bolton? We diagnose and fix most faults the same day, with no hidden charges.
services_heading: Complete Gas & Boiler Services Across Bolton
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full system installations, we handle every aspect of your heating with care and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Boiler Repairs
services.desc: No heat in winter? We aim to attend Bolton callouts within the hour. Most faults — leaks, no ignition, pressure loss — diagnosed and fixed on the spot.

services.title: Annual Boiler Servicing
services.desc: Keep your boiler running efficiently and safely with an annual gas safety check. We'll clean components, test controls, and spot issues before they become costly.

services.title: New Boiler Installation
services.desc: Upgrading your heating? We install condensing boilers that cut fuel bills by up to 30%. Full removal of the old unit, system balancing, and a 10-year manufacturer's warranty included.

services.title: Heating System Upgrades
services.desc: Uneven heating across rooms? We design and fit bespoke heating systems — radiator additions, underfloor heating, and smart controls — tailored to your home.

services.title: Gas Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Smell gas? We locate leaks safely using specialist equipment and repair them quickly. All work completed to Gas Safe standards.

services.title: Landlord Certificates & Inspections
services.desc: Stay compliant with annual landlord gas safety inspections and receive your official certificate. Essential for lettings.

about_pullquote: I started M.E Boilers because I hated seeing customers overcharged for simple fixes.
about_para_1: M.E Boilers was founded over 12 years ago by a frustrated plumber tired of watching Bolton homeowners get ripped off by call centres and cowboys. Today, we're the engineer neighbours trust when their heating fails — whether that's a frozen condensate pipe at 2am or a boiler that's finally given up the ghost. Every job is treated as if we're fixing our own home.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on speed, honesty, and fair pricing. We carry parts on the van, diagnose jobs properly before quoting, and never charge a callout fee. Repeat customers make up over 60% of our work — that's not luck, it's because we show up when we say we will and we actually fix the problem.
reviews_heading: What Bolton Customers Say About M.E Boilers

reviews.text: Boiler packed in on Boxing Day morning. Phoned M.E Boilers and they were here by midday. Parts were on the van, job done by 2pm. Fair price, no drama, exactly what you want at Christmas. Top bloke.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Been using them for annual servicing for 5 years now. They're reliable, always turn up on time, explain what they're doing, and the price hasn't jumped. Genuine local business you can trust.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Called after my radiators went cold. New boiler wasn't an option I could afford, so I asked if it could be fixed. They spent time checking it properly and got it running again for a fraction of the cost. Proper honest service.
reviews.author: James W.
